tool.title: OpenAPI ingest from source
tool.description: Ingest the OpenAPI documents an instance's `cat-openapi.config.json` lists under `documents` from a local checkout of their repository, read AT a branch, tag or commit (`git show`), verbatim, with a provenance recording the resolved commit and the document's sha256. `--check` verifies the committed copies offline.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance root holding `cat-openapi.config.json` and the declared `openapi` directory.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: A local checkout of the documents' repository.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The branch, tag or commit to read each document at. Default: the checkout's HEAD.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: `<id>.openapi.json` and `<id>.source.json` per document, in the declared `openapi` directory.

selection.when: An instance holds an OpenAPI spec whose source is a repository (e.g. a gateway's spec file) and the KG should describe it, pinned to a commit.
selection.limits: Reads a LOCAL checkout; fetching the repository is the caller's. A document that is not OpenAPI 3 fails rather than being written.
selection.cost: One git read and one JSON parse per document. No network.

$comment.comment:
── The two OpenAPI ingest tools — bean `folio-assistant-7jkp`, owner
ruling 2026-10-10: two tools, not one with a mode, because a repository
and a published URL are different inputs that fail differently. Both
write into the instance's declared `openapi` directory, verbatim, with a
`folio-openapi-source/v1` provenance beside each document, and
`ingest-openapi.ts --check` verifies either kind offline.
